Xingxing Song 宋星星

I am an undergraduate in Artificial Intelligence at Beijing Jiaotong University, where I work with Prof. Jitao Sang in the ADAM Lab. I previously worked with Prof. Jia Li at the College of AI, Tsinghua University. I am currently an Agent Development Intern at Meituan, working on agent workflows, skill evolution, and knowledge management.

My research interests lie in LLM post-training, agentic reinforcement learning, and GUI agents, with a broader interest in long-horizon agents and recursive self-improvement (RSI). My current work focuses on building interactive environments for GUI agent training and developing trajectory-level, process-aware evaluation methods. I am particularly interested in how agents can reliably navigate interfaces, coordinate tools, and recover from failures across long-horizon tasks, and how they can use experience and feedback to improve their strategies, workflows, and ultimately their own improvement processes.

I expect to graduate in June 2028. Feel free to reach out if you are interested in these topics!

Research

GUITestScape: Towards Open-set Evaluation on Exploratory GUI Testing

Xiaoyi Chen, Yifei Gao, Yang Xu, Xingxing Song, Yi Zhang, Jitao Sang

arXiv Preprint, 2026
arXiv / paper

Developed the GUIJudge method and core implementation for trajectory-level evaluation of GUI agents, including UI-TARS and GUI-Owl. GUIJudge achieved 97.12% detection recall across a benchmark of 61 apps and 508 preset defects.

Scaling Mobile-Gym

Xingxing Song · ADAM Lab, Beijing Jiaotong University

Research Project, June 2026–Present

Built interactive environments for GUI agent post-training. Added 10 simulated apps and 150 parameterized tasks, bringing the environment to 38 apps and 566 tasks. Worked on UI interactions, state modeling, declarative navigation, and reproducible task execution.

Projects

SuperMuse: A Persistent Personal Agent

A personal agent with long-term memory, persistent execution, and scheduled follow-ups. Built around the Pi agent runtime and Temporal, it brings cloud-computer control and MobileGym phone interaction into one workspace, with visible execution, user confirmations, and human takeover.
